title: Global $o(1/k^2)$ Merit Complexity of Regularized Newton Methods for Convex Multiobjective Optimization
summary: We investigate a regularized Newton method for unconstrained convex multi-objective optimization with twice continuously differentiable objectives whose Hessians are Lipschitz continuous. At each iteration, the method minimizes the quadratically regularized max-envelope of the local quadratic models. Using a Tanabe-type merit function, we prove that this merit decays at the global asymptotic rate $o(1/k^2)$ under the compactness assumption on the initial component-wise lower level set.
